source_state: Uncommitted standards implementation; production src and root Cargo manifests unchanged. Added API contract and workload factory tests.
instrumentation: Default cfg(coverage); host all-feature tests and example tests. Instrumented library source only in report.
inline_test_modules: Included where tests reside inside src files. This is file-scoped library-source coverage, not a test-free production-code denominator.
exclusions: tests, benches, examples and verification source excluded from the metric denominator; host tests and example tests execute. Benchmarks are not timed or executed by this command.
interpretation: Same-scope execution coverage after the added tests, not attainment of the high targets or proof of complete semantic API coverage.
